system.effect:
Prerequisites: Minor Gift – Faller
Drain 2 AP – Extended Action
Trigger: You finish an Extended Rest
Effect: Choose Chilled, Darkvision, Gilled, Glow, Heater, Magnetic, Mindlock, Naturewalk in one terrain of your choice, or Wallclimber. If used in the Campaign, you may add Gravitic Tolerance (1-3), and Gravitic Tolerance (2-4) to the list. Gain that Capability until the end of your next Extended Rest. This may be triggered multiple times from a single Extended Rest.
